summary: Captured two lessons learned from the 40 item usage/dormant audit into the wonder-cookbook skill and CB-bigquery data-research-patterns playbook: (1) trailing 'F' suffix on 40* item numbers is a real distinct frozen-variant item, not an annotation to strip, and (2) R&D/DRAFT status alone can't determine whether a menu item is a stale test draft or active WIP -- needs human confirmation. Also documented that item_version_change_logs.is_system_action under-flags known service accounts (SCC_SYNC, Wonder Create).
